extracted.name: Pumpkin, Oat & Cinnamon Muffins!
extracted.description: We’re in pumpkin season, so I’m going to share this delicious muffin recipe with you, where the base is pumpkin!! You can use pumpkin or butternut squash, either one will taste great! I used more oats than flour to make them healthier, and the result couldn’t have been better. I couldn’t leave out the touch of cinnamon, with pumpkin, it’s the perfect combination!! Are you up for giving them a try?? 😜
ingredient_lines: 10.6 oz (300 gr) raw pumpkin (peeled and seeded)
1 1/3 cups (300 gr) vegetable oil (sunflower or canola)
1 little extra sugar and cinnamon for sprinkling on top
instruction_lines: Prepare the pumpkin: Peel it, remove the seeds, clean it, and cut it into small chunks. Weigh out 300 g (10.6 oz) and place it in a blender along with the 1⅓ cups of oil. Blend until you get a pumpkin purée.
Mix the dry ingredients: Pour the puréed mixture into a large bowl and add: sugar, rolled oats, all-purpose flour and baking powder.
Add cinnamon and eggs: Add the 1½ teaspoons cinnamon and the 5 eggs, then mix everything with a hand mixer until smooth.
Fill the muffin cups: Once the batter is ready, spoon it into the muffin molds, filling them to about one finger below the rim.
Optional topping: Sprinkle a little sugar and cinnamon on top so they form a crispy layer when baked.

Bake: Preheat the oven first (380F🇺🇸 or 180C🇪🇸). Bake the muffins until they rise and turn golden on top. Check doneness by inserting a toothpick or knife into the center—if it comes out clean, they’re done.
Finished result: The muffins will be moist and soft inside. Enjoy them!!!
